summary: Aligned the B&S page frame, tab strips, and save bar to the DFM window layout so the tab strip meets the frame and the bottom of the page is no longer cut off.
details: The bordered page frame now shares the tab strip's left and right gutter, so the strip's bottom rule meets the frame corners and the active tab sits flush on it.
The page frame is sized as a row of the window instead of a full-height block, so the last rows of the Details form and the Method table are no longer clipped behind the save bar.
The Method tab's calculation tabs now enclose their own framed area like the inner tab control in ResQ, so the caption and grid sit inside a closed box under the active calculation tab.
The calculation grid now fills that area instead of stopping at the last row, which previously left a large empty gap under the table on views with no summary strip.
Removed the "Calculated from annual source data." line under the caption; the message row now appears only to report a calculation failure, so the caption sits directly on the grid as in ResQ.
The save bar sits on the window canvas like DFM and Bornhuetter Ferguson instead of drawing a second frame, and the Notes tab scrolls inside the frame.
